findings.detail: E07 source count 749 combines the current-period SOI investment rows with prior-period SOI investment rows; output count 385 is the current-period scope.

rationale: Raw source shows two separate SOI blocks with the same investment-table structure. The current-period block begins at table 12 and ties to the December 31, 2025 non-control/non-affiliate investment total of 7,433,861 at table 22 row 28, matching the flagged quarter's extracted current schedule scope. A second matching SOI block begins at table 26 and ties to the prior-period total of 6,899,031 at table 36 row 13. The flagged source/output mismatch is therefore explained by the E07 source-side count including comparative/prior-period rows, while the output count 385 is correctly limited to the current report date.
